purpose: Dual-branch system on the project's native 18-channel data: branch A = adversarially trained EEGNet 1D CNN (closed-set identity, #1-#4 + #7), branch B = E65 correlation-logSPD PCA-96 / k=12 prototype gate (#5/#6 + unknown rejection). Fusion = 0 if gate rejects, else branch A argmax. Measure all ten gates honestly.

protocol.blocks_rule: block = clip(int(frac * 5), 0, 4) per (subject, task) trial order

branch_a.input_normalisation: per-trial channel mean removal, then divide by per-trial global RMS (differentiable, inside forward)
branch_a.early_stop: full model only: best eval-block (0.6<frac<=0.8) clean accuracy
branch_a.pgd_eps_definition: L-infinity bound = eps * per-trial global RMS (~34 dB); step = 2*eps/steps * RMS, sign gradient, random start

branch_b.standardisation: per-task z-score, statistics from all Train rows of that task (Train-only, E170 rule)
branch_b.threshold_rule: work point at 90% known acceptance: tau = 0.10 quantile of the 5-block Train OOF scores (E170/E178 convention `quantile(ref, 1 - a)`); prototypes for block b exclude block b
branch_b.loso: 20 folds; prototypes from pm & fit_rows (19 enrolled identities); known = enrolled window rows, unknown = held-out identity window rows

fusion.primary: if branch-B score < tau -> label 0 else branch-A argmax
fusion.dual_gate_variant: additionally require branch-A max softmax >= its Train OOF 0.90 quantile

attack.domain: Train window block 0.6 < frac <= 0.8 (identity labels available); stratified cap 400 per task
attack.why_train: Test has no identity labels, so RA/ASafeR cannot be computed there
attack.eps_definition: L-infinity bound = eps * per-trial global RMS

goals.A: impersonation: maximise (best wrong branch-A logit - true logit)/T
goals.B: broad confusion: maximise (logsumexp over wrong branch-A logits - true logit)/T
goals.C: boundary impersonation: maximise (next-identity logit - true logit)/T
goals.D: gate evasion: maximise z(branch-B score), i.e. push the trial into the accept region

attack.goal_note: A/B/C attack the identity head only (E178 style, no gate term); D attacks the gate only. The worst case over all four is reported for #7/#8, so neither branch can be 'won' by ignoring it.
attack.primary_gate_reading: gate #7 = lowest RA over all eps x goals, gate #8 = lowest ASafeR

reporting.test_official: N/A: Test has no public identity labels; AUC/F1/C/RA/ASafeR/U/Score are not computable
reporting.session_usage: Test predictions and thresholds are frozen Train-only; the Session column is read only after all predictions are written, for the #9/#10 audit
